samples.summary: VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES covers only 4 of the 8 `eager: true` families the app's own bootstrap link actually requests
samples.evidence: `ensureGoogleFontsLink()` builds its href from every `webFont && eager` catalog entry (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts:112-114). The generated source of truth lists EIGHT eager families: Noto Sans KR (font-catalog.data.ts:6), Noto Serif KR (:7), Nanum Gothic (:8), Nanum Myeongjo (:9), Gothic A1 (:13), Gowun Dodum (:14), Gowun Batang (:15), Roboto (:49). The diff's list names only four of them, so Nanum Myeongjo / Gothic A1 / Gowun Dodum / Gowun Batang remain in exactly the un-awaited state the PR is fixing for Inter. The eager set is machine-generated (packages/frontend/scripts/build-font-catalog.mjs:41 `const EAGER = new Set([...])`), so re-running the generator will silently widen it again with nothing updating the hardcoded script list. Fix belongs in verify-visual-browser.mjs:346 (or better, derive the list from FONT_CATALOG's eager entries).

samples.summary: New all-families × all-weights hard check demands weights index.html never requests; a miss turns a pixel diff into a 10s hard lane failure
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/index.html:12 requests `Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700` (no 400) and `JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500` (no 600/700), while the new gate (verify-visual-browser.mjs:384-393) requires `document.fonts.check()` to be true for every family at 400/500/600/700. It also assumes CSS weight-matching resolves the absent cuts to a loaded face; if that assumption is wrong for any family/weight pair (e.g. the variable-axis Fraunces registration), the waitForFunction throws and the whole visual lane hard-fails instead of producing a diff. The bootstrap URL is also duplicated in packages/documentation/.vitepress/config.ts:24, so a future narrowing of the weight list in either place is not reflected in the script.

samples.summary: Sibling screenshot script still uses the weak bare `document.fonts.ready` the PR just proved insufficient
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/scripts/capture-docs-screenshots.mjs:80-81 does `if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) await document.fonts.ready;` with no load()/check() pass and no post-mount ordering — exactly the pattern the diff replaces because `fonts.ready` can resolve while a remote Inter face is still unusable. Docs screenshots captured by this script can therefore still bake the serif fallback. Not updated by this change.

samples.summary: Comment attributes the first four families to a hook the visual harness never mounts, so half the enumerated list is inert in this lane
samples.evidence: The new comment says the Korean families + Roboto are "Injected lazily by useGoogleFontsLink() from a component mount effect", but that hook is only called from packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-view.tsx:230 and packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-view.tsx:210, and no harness file references SlidesView/DocsView (grep over packages/frontend/src/app/harness returned nothing). The harness mounts panels standalone (e.g. slides-scenarios.tsx:1821 renders ThemedFontPicker directly), so no bootstrap link is injected and those four check() calls pass only via system fallback — the comment describes a contract the lane does not exercise.

verdict.reason: The code is present exactly as described. index.html:12 requests Fraunces at 500/600/700 only and JetBrains Mono at 400/500 only, while verify-visual-browser.mjs:362 and :384-393 hard-wait (10s waitForFunction, which throws on timeout) on document.fonts.check() being true for every enumerated family at 400/500/600/700. The mismatch is in fact wider: font-catalog.ts:94 requests DEFAULT_WEIGHTS '400;700' for the lazily injected families, so 500/600 are unrequested for those as well. The bootstrap URL is duplicated verbatim at packages/documentation/.vitepress/config.ts:24 and neither copy is linked to the script's weight list, so a future narrowing in either place diverges silently. Whether the gate actually fails depends on FontFaceSet.check() resolving unrequested weights onto a nearest-weight face; that is my reading of the matching semantics and likely Chromium's behaviour, but it is runtime behaviour I could not execute or confirm from the repo, and the task note (docs/tasks/active/20260811-visual-inter-font-race-todo.md:48-56) records only `pnpm verify:fast`, not a real browser-lane run. Since I cannot concretely rule out the fail-closed hard timeout, and the dependency lives in files outside the diff (blast-radius lane), the finding stays.
